title: Transcription: chunk claim, dispatch, provider, accept, finalize, store and serve, plus the talk-time view.

fields.name: transcript_state
fields.doc: The transcriptions.status the checker read, or none when the Recording has no row.

fields.name: transcript_job_state
fields.doc: The artifact_jobs.state the checker read.

fields.name: transcript_job_kind
fields.doc: Which job row the item is: an artifact_jobs kind, or render for the Recording's export job.

fields.name: transcript_recording_state
fields.doc: The recordings.status the checker read.

fields.name: transcript_prep_state
fields.doc: The recording_jobs row's state (kind transcription for audio preparation, render for export), or none when absent.

fields.name: transcript_attempt_state
fields.doc: A transcription_attempts row's state.

fields.name: transcript_mode
fields.doc: The Episode's transcription mode from its config snapshot.

fields.name: transcript_dispatch_source
fields.doc: What invoked the dispatcher (dispatcher.ts QUEUES_BY_SOURCE).

fields.name: transcript_queue
fields.doc: Which dispatcher queue drained.

fields.name: transcript_route
fields.doc: Which read path a transcript.document_read op measured.

fields.name: transcript_talk_status
fields.doc: The status the talk-time endpoint served.

fields.name: transcript_r2_result
fields.doc: What the checker's readback of the stored document found.

fields.name: transcript_error_code
fields.doc: The dispatcher's safe error code, as stored on the job and reported in retry decisions.

fields.name: transcript_exists
fields.doc: Whether the db row this observation names exists.

fields.name: transcript_in_progress
fields.doc: How many Recordings talk-time counted as still transcribing.

fields.name: transcript_cue_count
fields.doc: How many cues a document or readback holds.

fields.name: transcript_count
fields.doc: How many assignments a dispatcher claim returned.

fields.name: transcript_attempt_count
fields.doc: A job row's attempt_count.

fields.name: transcript_attempt_limit
fields.doc: A job row's attempt_limit.

fields.name: transcript_open_jobs
fields.doc: How many open artifact jobs a transcription has (pending, leased or retryable).

fields.name: transcript_dead_letter_jobs
fields.doc: How many dead_letter artifact jobs a transcription has.

fields.name: transcript_latest_job
fields.doc: Whether this job item is its transcription's latest artifact job.

fields.name: transcript_chunk_count
fields.doc: How many source chunks a transcription has.

fields.name: transcript_terminal_ms
fields.doc: The row's terminal_at, in Unix milliseconds; absent when not terminal.

fields.name: transcript_available_ms
fields.doc: The job row's available_at, in Unix milliseconds.

fields.name: transcript_lease_expiry_ms
fields.doc: The job row's lease_expires_at, in Unix milliseconds.

fields.name: transcript_created_ms
fields.doc: The row's created_at, in Unix milliseconds.

fields.name: transcript_updated_ms
fields.doc: The row's updated_at, in Unix milliseconds.

fields.name: transcript_completed_ms
fields.doc: The row's completed_at, in Unix milliseconds.

fields.name: transcript_deleted
fields.doc: Whether the transcriptions row has deleted_at set.

fields.name: transcript_artifact_set
fields.doc: Whether artifact_key, artifact_size and artifact_content_type are all stored.

fields.name: transcript_sha_set
fields.doc: Whether artifact_sha256 is stored.

fields.name: transcript_generation
fields.doc: The transcript's generation, or the attempt row's generation.

fields.name: transcript_provider
fields.doc: The provider an attempt row names (openrouter is the MAI provider's name).

fields.name: transcript_observed_ms
fields.doc: An attempt's provider_observed_duration_ms: the speech the provider measured.

fields.name: transcript_finished_ms
fields.doc: An attempt row's finished_at, in Unix milliseconds.

fields.name: transcript_size_bytes
fields.doc: Bytes the readback returned.

fields.name: transcript_sha_match
fields.doc: Whether the readback's sha256 equals the stored artifact_sha256.

fields.name: transcript_recordings
fields.doc: How many Recordings of the Episode the checker read.

fields.name: transcript_speech_ms
fields.doc: Speech the -45 dB gate measured in a chunk's audio.

fields.name: transcript_chunk_index
fields.doc: Which chunk of the source a row is about.

fields.name: transcript_claimed
fields.doc: How many assignments a claim response carried.

fields.name: transcript_has_row
fields.doc: Whether this Recording has a transcriptions row.

fields.name: transcript_dead
fields.doc: Whether this Recording's transcription is dead: it counted as in progress but can never complete.

fields.name: transcript_first_retry_code
fields.doc: The latest error_code of the transcription's first job with attempt_count > 1.

fields.name: transcript_first_retry_kind
fields.doc: The kind of the transcription's first job with attempt_count > 1.

events.name: transcript.wake
events.doc: The API's wake call to the dispatcher for a job: queued (accepted) or failed (unavailable, encoding, invoke or rejected status), always with the job it was for.

events.name: transcript.claim
events.doc: One decision per claimed job, plus none (nothing claimable) or repository_error per call. The lease commits before URL signing, so url_failed, invalid_assignment and lease_stale name the orphaned-lease fault of issue #1510.

events.name: transcript.finalize_claim
events.doc: One decision per claimed finalizer job, plus none or repository_error per call; url_failed when chunk GET or output PUT signing fails after the lease committed.

events.name: transcript.job_retry
events.doc: After the retry service commits: retryable or dead_letter, with the dispatcher's safe error code and the attempt it ended.

events.name: transcript.job_complete
events.doc: The result-accept decision: accepted, rejected (result verification failed) or error (the accept call failed).

events.name: transcript.finalize_accept
events.doc: The finalizer-accept decision: accepted, rejected (artifact verification failed) or error.

events.name: transcript.finalize_retry
events.doc: After RetryFinalizer commits: retryable or dead_letter, with the error code.

events.name: transcript.document_read
events.doc: Reading a stored transcript document, on the document route or inside talk-time: ok, expected(transcript.not_ready), or error(object_get, artifact_mismatch, decode). Never the body.

events.name: transcript.talk_time_served
events.doc: The status the Episode talk-time endpoint served and how many Recordings it counted as still transcribing.

events.name: transcript.dispatcher.invoke
events.doc: One dispatcher invocation: a wake, a scheduled reconcile, or a targeted drain. Field transcript_dispatch_source names what called it; job_id is set on wake dispatches.

events.name: transcript.chunk
events.doc: One chunk assignment's terminal: ok after the control plane accepted the result, expected(transcript.late_completion) on the 409 path, or error(transcript.<safe error code>).

events.name: transcript.finalize
events.doc: One finalizer assignment's terminal: ok, expected(transcript.late_completion), or error(transcript.<safe error code>), with the merged document's cue count.

events.name: transcript.db.job
events.doc: The checker's read of the item's artifact_jobs row. Emitted by the evidence reader, never a program.

events.name: transcript.db.transcription
events.doc: The checker's read of the transcriptions row for the item's transcript; transcript_exists false means the Recording has none.

events.name: transcript.db.recording
events.doc: The checker's read of the Recording row behind the item, one per Recording of the Episode for episode items.

events.name: transcript.db.prep
events.doc: The checker's read of the latest recording_jobs row of kind transcription for the item's Recording; transcript_exists false means no preparation row.

events.name: transcript.db.attempt
events.doc: The checker's read of one transcription_attempts row of the item's transcript (its own chunk for a chunk job, every chunk for the finalize job).

events.name: transcript.db.render
events.doc: The checker's read of the item's own recording_jobs row when the item is the Recording's export (render) job.

events.name: transcript.db.episode
events.doc: The checker's read of the Episode's transcription mode and how many of its Recordings exist, for episode items.

events.name: transcript.r2.object
events.doc: The checker's own readback of the stored document: what it found, its size, cue count and whether the bytes match the stored sha256.

events.name: transcript.db.talk
events.doc: The talk-time status the checker's db read expects: it replays transcriptInProgress, including its dead-Recording bug.

reasons.doc: The document route was asked for a transcription that has no artifact yet.
The object store could not return the transcript artifact.
The stored object's key, size or content type does not match the transcriptions row.
The stored document did not decode or failed transcript.v1 validation.
The result object failed verification at chunk accept.
The final artifact failed verification at finalizer accept.
The accept or finalize-accept call itself failed.
The control plane refused a completion or retry because the lease moved on or the work finished already.
The API's wake call to the dispatcher did not queue.
The claimed job's assignment could not be built (missing chunk, source or manifest).
The claimed lease had already expired when the assignment was built.
Signing a chunk, manifest or output URL failed after the lease committed.
The claim's repository call failed.
The claim found no claimable job.
The transcription provider timed out.
The transcription provider's response failed schema validation.
The transcription provider rate-limited the request.
The transcription provider answered 5xx.
The transcription provider rejected the request non-retryably.
The job's lease expired before its attempt ended; recovered jobs carry this reason.
The dispatcher's deadline or cancel signal fired.
The dispatcher failed in a way its error classifier could not name.
A fetch failed at the network layer inside the dispatcher.
The control plane rejected the dispatcher's call.
The dispatcher judged the assignment's data invalid.
A chunk or manifest download failed retryably inside the dispatcher.
An error the dispatcher classified only by its safe code.

machines.name: transcript.job
machines.doc: The artifact_jobs.state of a transcription job (chunk or finalize), committed by the worker repository.

machines.name: transcript.status
machines.doc: The transcriptions.status of a transcript. Only verifying to complete is emitted today (the finalizer's completion commit).

facts.name: transcript.job_state
facts.doc: The item's artifact_jobs row, read by the checker from Postgres. Claim: its state.

facts.name: transcript.row
facts.doc: The item's transcriptions row, read by the checker. Claim: its status; transcript_exists false means the Recording has none.

facts.name: transcript.recording
facts.doc: The Recording row behind the item (one per Recording for episode items). Claim: its status.

facts.name: transcript.prep
facts.doc: The Recording's latest recording_jobs row of kind transcription. Claim: its state; transcript_exists false means the preparation row was never written.

facts.name: transcript.attempts
facts.doc: The transcription_attempts rows of the item's transcript: its own chunk's attempts for a chunk job, every chunk's for the finalize job. Claim: each attempt's state.

facts.name: transcript.render
facts.doc: The item's recording_jobs row when the item is the Recording's export job. Claim: its state.

facts.name: transcript.episode
facts.doc: The Episode's transcription mode and Recording count, read by the checker for episode items.

facts.name: transcript.object
facts.doc: The checker's readback of the stored document from r2. Claim: what the read found.

facts.name: transcript.wake_decision
facts.doc: The API's wake decisions for the item's job. Claim: queued or failed.

facts.name: transcript.claim_decision
facts.doc: The API's claim decisions for the item's job. Claim: what was decided.

facts.name: transcript.finalize_claim_decision
facts.doc: The API's finalize-claim decisions for the item's job. Claim: what was decided.

facts.name: transcript.retry_decision
facts.doc: The API's retry decisions for the item's job: the dispatcher's error code reaching the control plane. Claim: retryable or dead_letter.

facts.name: transcript.complete_decision
facts.doc: The API's accept decisions for the item's job. Claim: accepted, rejected or error.

facts.name: transcript.finalize_accept_decision
facts.doc: The API's finalize-accept decisions for the item's job. Claim: accepted, rejected or error.

facts.name: transcript.finalize_retry_decision
facts.doc: The API's finalize-retry decisions for the item's job. Claim: retryable or dead_letter.

facts.name: transcript.doc
facts.doc: Document-read ops that read the item's transcript artifact (document route and talk-time). Claim: the op's outcome.

facts.name: transcript.talk
facts.doc: The status the Episode talk-time endpoint served (api) against what the stored rows imply (db). Claim: the status.

facts.name: transcript.chunk_op
facts.doc: The dispatcher's chunk-work terminals for the item's job. Claim: the op's outcome.

facts.name: transcript.finalize_op
facts.doc: The dispatcher's finalize-work terminals for the item's job. Claim: the op's outcome.

facts.name: transcript.invoke
facts.doc: Dispatcher invocations bound to the item's job (wake dispatches carry it). Claim: the op's outcome.

symptoms.doc: A transcription job reached dead_letter, or the transcription reached terminal_failure.

witnesses.doc: The job row: state, error code, attempts and terminal time.

witnesses.query: psql -c "select * from transcriptions where id = (select transcript_id from artifact_jobs where id = '{job}')"
witnesses.doc: The transcription's status.
The dispatcher's error code reaching the control plane.
The finalizer's error code reaching the control plane.
The dispatcher's terminal for the chunk.
The dispatcher's terminal for the finalizer.

symptoms.doc: The transcription is complete but its stored document is missing, differs from the recorded metadata, fails validation, or the API failed to read a document that is in fact readable.

witnesses.query: psql -c "select * from transcriptions where id = (select transcript_id from artifact_jobs where id = '{job}')"
witnesses.doc: The status and recorded artifact metadata.
The checker's own readback of the stored document.
Document reads the API attempted in the window.

symptoms.doc: A claimed chunk attempt's lease expired with no accepted result and no accepted retry, so the work was silently dropped and waits for lease recovery.

witnesses.doc: The job row: leased with an expired lease, or a recovered row with error_code lease_expired.

witnesses.query: psql -c "select * from transcription_attempts where chunk_id = (select chunk_id from artifact_jobs where id = '{job}')"
witnesses.doc: The attempts the control plane recorded.
How the attempt's lease committed: leased, or the claim-handler failure decisions of issue #1510.
Whether an accepted result exists for the attempt.
Whether the attempt was reported retryable or dead.
The dispatcher's terminal for the attempt; its absence after a claim is the open gap.

symptoms.doc: A transcription stopped moving: a job waits unclaimed, a lease outlived its expiry with no work recorded, a transcription sits mid-pipeline with no open job, or an automatic Recording never got a transcription.

witnesses.doc: The job's state, available_at and lease expiry.

witnesses.query: psql -c "select * from transcriptions where id = (select transcript_id from artifact_jobs where id = '{job}')"
witnesses.doc: The transcription's status and last update.

witnesses.query: psql -c "select * from recordings where id = (select recording_id from artifact_jobs where id = '{job}')"
witnesses.doc: The Recording's status and completion time.

witnesses.query: psql -c "select * from recording_jobs where recording_id = '<rec>' and kind = 'transcription'"
witnesses.doc: The audio-preparation job slice 10 owns.
The item's own row when it is the Recording's export job.
Chunk claims in the last five minutes pick the schedule-vs-worker attribution.
Finalizer claims in the last five minutes pick the schedule-vs-worker attribution.

symptoms.doc: The transcript completed more than 60 minutes after the transcription row was created.
user_words: the transcript took over an hour

witnesses.query: psql -c "select * from transcriptions where id = (select transcript_id from artifact_jobs where id = '{job}')"
witnesses.doc: created_at and completed_at.
The finalize job's row: attempts and latest error code for attribution.

symptoms.doc: The dispatcher measured at least 2000 ms of speech in the audio, but the stored document has zero cues.

witnesses.query: psql -c "select * from transcriptions where id = (select transcript_id from artifact_jobs where id = '{job}')"
witnesses.doc: The transcription is complete.

witnesses.query: psql -c "select * from transcription_attempts a join transcript_chunks c on a.chunk_id = c.id where a.transcript_id = (select transcript_id from artifact_jobs where id = '{job}')"
witnesses.doc: Each chunk's accepted attempt and the speech the provider measured.
The checker's readback: the stored document's cue count.

symptoms.doc: Talk-time answers transcript_pending for an Episode where no transcript can arrive.

witnesses.query: psql -c "select config_snapshot from episodes where id = '{episode}'"; reader: config_snapshot.artifact_policy.transcription.mode
witnesses.doc: The Episode's transcription mode and Recording count.
Every Recording's status and completion time.
Every transcription row of the Episode.

witnesses.query: psql -c "select * from recording_jobs where episode_id = '{episode}' and kind = 'transcription'"
witnesses.doc: Every preparation row of the Episode.
The live answer the endpoint served.

symptoms.doc: The API's wake call to the dispatcher failed, and the first claim came more than 90 s after the job was created.

witnesses.doc: The wake decisions for this job.
The first leased claim's time.
Finalizer claims are the pickup for finalize jobs.
The job's created_at is the 90-second clock's start.
